title: KV cache quant profiles: staged shadowing, rollback protocol, and SLA tuning
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run and validate a staged shadowing experiment for INT8/FP8 KV cache profiles that enables safe automated rollbacks and SLA-aware tuning. Goal: quantify latency, P99/P95, and per-task quality regressions across representative workloads, and implement a lightweight rollback protocol that can be executed at serving time with minimal operator intervention.
acceptance_criteria: Shadowing pipeline runs end-to-end on 3 workload classes (chat-short, chat-long, rerank) and produces per-profile metrics
Rollback protocol validated in canary and does not increase tail latency by >5% over baseline within 95% confidence
Latency-quality Pareto curves produced for FP8 vs INT8 KV profiles; recommended default profile for each workload documented
Runbook for automated rollback + audit logging is merged and annotated in Confluence
tasks: Define sample prompt sets for short-chat, long-chat, and reranking (owner: Priya Kapoor)
Implement shadowing harness to route live requests to quantized KV variants without impacting responses (owner: Daniel Ortiz)
Add metric hooks for token-level divergence, n-gram overlap, and eval-based quality scoring (owner: Rafael Gomez)
Run controlled A/B on staging fleet using traffic replay to simulate realistic cache hit distributions (owner: Eng Reliability)
Design and implement rollback API and audit trail (owner: Security Infra)
Analyze results, pick per-workload profile, and document recommended defaults and SLO knobs (owner: Maya Chen)
Prepare runtime-1.24 rollout checklist and mitigation plan (owner: Release Eng)
metrics: Per-request quality delta (BLEU-like and semantic sim)
results_summary: Initial staged shadowing across three representative workloads shows that INT8 KV achieves median token latency improvements of ~11% and cost reduction ~18% vs FP32 baseline, with a mean quality delta of +0.1% to -1.9% depending on workload. FP8 KV profiles improved latency slightly over INT8 on small-sequence chat (median ~2.5%) but exhibited larger variance on long chat workloads and occasional tail-quality regressions. We observed that aggressive per-head asymmetry in calibration produced isolated regressions; per-layer re-scaling mitigated most of these.
comments: 2025-10-10 — Daniel Ortiz: Prototype shadow harness committed (GH PR #4821). Uses request duplicator + off-path recorder to compare outputs. Initial perf overhead on shadow path is 3% due to tracing. Marking 'integration' target.

2025-10-17 — Priya Kapoor: Curated prompt sets checked in to eval repo (samples/chat-short.json, samples/chat-long.json, samples/rerank.json). These include realistic prefix distributions and KV hit patterns.

2025-10-22 — Rafael Gomez: Added semantic-sim scoring to the eval harness using embedding cosine with threshold-based regression flags. Early thresholds produce too many false positives; we tightened to >0.04 absolute drop for flagging.

2025-10-29 — Maya Chen: Shadow runs for INT8/FP8 on staging 12-node pool finished. Collected 48h of traffic-replay results; parsed to parquet and uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-eval/kv-shadow/eng-91234/).
2025-11-01 — Eng Reliability: Replay job exposed a scheduling hotspot when shadow worker pinned to same GPU as baseline; we implemented soft-isolation (cgroups) as short-term mitigation.

2025-11-03 — Security Infra: Rollback API design reviewed. API exposes a single-step policy: enable-profile(profile_name) with audit-log entry. We added requirement for operator confirmation in production-managed Dedicated clusters.

2025-11-04 — Maya Chen: Analysis complete. Draft recommendation: default to INT8-tiered profile for chat-short and rerank; use conservative FP8-mid profile for chat-long until per-head calibration runs are automated. Ready for PM review.
decisions: Adopt a staged shadowing approach rather than inline progressive rollout to reduce blast radius and capture quality deltas without affecting users
Require audit-log-backed rollback API for Dedicated customers; can be manual-confirm on initial rollout, automated for low-risk tiers later
Set initial divergence threshold for automated rollback to semantic-sim drop >0.05 AND n-gram delta >3% over 1k-sample window
Prefer INT8-tiered profile as default for short-chat and rerank based on current experiments; defer long-chat FP8 adoption until per-head calibration automation is in place
next_steps: Finalize runbook and rollout checklist and circulate to Solutions and Security for feedback (target: 2025-11-10)
Automate per-head calibration sweep and integrate into nightly calibration job (owner: Research, target: Cycle 42)
Implement a lightweight fallback policy in the router: if rollback rate >0.2% sustained for 10m, auto-switch to baseline model variant
Schedule a Dedicated small-customer pilot for conservative FP8 profile (contact: acme-corp success manager)
Run a smoke test during maintenance window to exercise rollback API and audit logs end-to-end
